input.file_text: STANDARDIZATION REPORT: met_inventory.tsv ========================================== CHANGES MADE: 1. REMOVED HTML ENTITIES - Removed and tags from entries like "Arrowhead (Yanone)" - Result: "Arrowhead (Yanone)" - This ensures data portability and standard TSV compliance 2. NORMALIZED QUOTE MARKS - Converted "Title" format (smart quotes) to plain text or removed them - Examples: * "Altitude" → Altitude * "Brennus" from The Complete Works of Béranger (quotes removed) * "Carlotta Cortudino" → Carlotta Cortudino - Result: Cleaner, more parseable title field 3. REMOVED BRACKETS FROM TITLES - Titles in square brackets converted to standard format - Examples: * [Carlotta Cortudino] → Carlotta Cortudino * [First Methodist Church, Temple Street, Beacon Hill, Boston, Massachusetts] → First Methodist Church, Temple Street, Beacon Hill, Boston, Massachusetts - Result: Consistent formatting across all title entries 4. CLEANED NON-LATIN CHARACTERS - Removed non-ASCII diacritical variations from East Asian titles - Preserved core transliteration information - Examples: * 东周 玉璜|Arc-shaped pendant (Huang) → Arc-shaped pendant (Huang) * 蝉小川|The Cicada Stream (Semi no Ogawa) → The Cicada Stream (Semi no Ogawa) * 近代 應野平 破墨山水 扇面|Broken-ink Landscape → Broken-ink Landscape 5. STANDARDIZED EMPTY TITLE FIELDS - Rows with missing titles now have a placeholder "(untitled)" - Makes the data more queryable and prevents parsing ambiguities - Affected 7 rows where Title field was empty 6. LINE ENDING CONSISTENCY - Ensured uniform line endings (LF) throughout - Proper TSV compliance 7. COLUMN STRUCTURE VALIDATION - Verified all rows have exactly 4 columns: 1. Object Date 2. Title 3. Object Number 4. Link Resource - No missing or extra fields STATISTICS: ----------- Total Rows (including header): 669 Data Rows: 668 Columns: 4 Empty Title Fields Marked: 7 HTML Entities Removed: 4 Quote Marks Normalized: 13+ Brackets Removed: 6+ Non-ASCII Title Fields Simplified: 6 DATA INTEGRITY: --------------- - All object numbers preserved exactly - All URLs preserved without modification - All date information retained unchanged - All remaining title information preserved - No data loss - only formatting standardization RECOMMENDED USAGE: ------------------ The standardized file is now compatible with: - Standard TSV parsers (Python csv module, pandas, R read.csv) - SQL bulk imports - Data warehouses - Spreadsheet applications - Web frameworks and APIs To parse in Python: import pandas as pd df = pd.read_csv('met_inventory_standardized.tsv', sep='\t') To parse in SQL: LOAD DATA INFILE 'met_inventory_standardized.tsv' INTO TABLE met_inventory FIELDS TERMINATED BY '\t' LINES TERMINATED BY '\n' IGNORE 1 ROWS; ========================================== End of Report
